the stop sign. wi-1 observed that the driver of unit 1 was looking down at her cellular phone and then looked right before she quickly made a right turn and struck the walmart shopping cart that the pedestrian was pushing and the pedestrian too. the pedestrian fell to the floor and wi-1 quickly got on his knees to see what he could do to help her with . the pedestrian complained of paint o her waist, lower back and left knee. the pedestrian refused transport for treatment to her injuries. no other injuries or witnesses reported.

records.deidentified_narrative: unit 1 was traveling w/b out of a parking space and turned s/b [roadway] and came to stop at a stop sign/ stop line. unit 2 ( pedestrian ) was walking out of the walmart store and was walking in a slight n/e direction outside the crosswalk in the east / west roadway of the parking lot. driver of unit 1 was inattentive that unit 2 had exited the walmart store and was crossing the east/west roadway of the parking lot. when driver of unit 1 started to make a left turn, the front left of unit 1 struck unit 2, causing unit 2 to fall onto the roadway. when i/o arrived on scene, [medical facility] by dfr. driver of unit 1 who was shaken up stated to i/o that she had stopped at the stop sign and for a black pickup. driver 1 stated that the pickup had stopped and had its left turn signal on and was gonna make a left turn from the area that she was at. seeing that the pickup had stopped, driver 1 stated that she put unit 1 into motion and as she was making a left turn when she struck unit 2. i/[medical facility] to check on the pedestrian. unit 2 stated that she was walking out of the walmart store and was walking towards her vehicle in the parking lot when she was struck. unit 2 sustained internal injuries. when i/o asked unit 2 if she was in the crosswalk, unit 2 stated that she was. i/o asked unit 2 if she was looking ahead while walking or if she had her head turned. unit 2 stated that she was looking forward. unit 2 stated that she saw the black pickup stop as she walking across the roadway. walmart had an exterior camera that captured this incident and a copy of the incident was given to i/o. in the video, unit 2 is about 2 feet to the east of the crosswalk and had looked down and than looked back up at which time she saw unit 1 coming towards her. unit 2 put out her left hand to brace the hood of unit 1. after bracing herself, unit 2 rotated and fell onto the roadway. the crash scene and all interviews were recorded on body worn camera. the video and/or photos were saved to evidence. com on id# 21-2281644. i/o took digital photos of the area of unit 1 that struck unit 2. the photos will be placed into dataworks.
